The energy balance calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, validating the core weighting logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While the calculation logic is robust, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor. Future iterations should verify that the weighted-risk assumptions remain consistent across varying campus energy input scales.
